title: Alert Echo Chamber
story: The alert router sent the same pages repeatedly. Before tuning it, the team needs a count by service instead of six identical screenshots.
objective: Create /reports/alert-counts.txt from /alerts/raw.txt. It must contain each service alphabetically with its occurrence count: database, gateway, then worker.
hints: uniq counts adjacent duplicates, so arrange equal lines next to each other first.
sort orders the service names; uniq -c counts each group.
explanation: sort groups identical lines and uniq -c counts adjacent groups. This combination is a fast way to summarize repeated values without changing the source.

files.content:
